name: Nahar-Dex, Driver of the Seven Swords
desc: If you control a monster and the total Levels of Effect Monsters you control are 7 or lower: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, but banish it when it leaves the field. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand: You can destroy as many other monsters on the field with a Level as possible, and if you do, this card gains 700 ATK for each card destroyed, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Nahar-Dex, Driver of the Seven Swords" once per turn.
